label: 🐘 Postgres
description: Read a table or custom query from a PostgreSQL database. The URI is a standard postgresql:// connection string.

table.label: Table name
table.help: Reads SELECT * FROM <table>. Supports schema-qualified names (e.g. public.users). Leave blank to use the custom query.

schema.label: Schema
schema.help: Defaults to 'public'. Ignored if 'table' is already schema-qualified.

query.label: Custom SQL query
query.help: Used when 'Table name' is empty. Executed verbatim against Postgres.
